# waymore 8.9

Unmodified MIT source from the official PyPI wheel, published by xnl-h4ck3r.

- Upstream: https://github.com/xnl-h4ck3r/waymore
- Package: https://pypi.org/project/waymore/8.9/
- Wheel SHA-256: e64e04b672af2a9b2bd6b27d19803ea78b4bb60af5b11e7211690f84061311cf
- License: `waymore-8.9.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE`

FindAll executes URL provider collection in `jf/waymore_worker.py`, with isolated
configuration, source host allowlists, bounded requests and process deadlines.
Pure upstream replay URL helpers are used by `jf/archives.py`. Archived response
capture uses FindAll's DNS-pinned transport, allowing only web.archive.org,
including redirects. Upstream files remain unchanged.
